items.text: Hi survivors,
It’s been about a week since our big 1.0 release, and we’ve received so many kind words, so much feedback and so many great suggestions. First of all: thank you!
This patch focuses on bug fixes and smaller improvements, including fixes for the crashes you reported most often.
Improvements
Stash management can now sort by type
Locked upgrades in Upgrades + Unlocks now show ??? and a dimmed icon
Run history now shows runs you quit as “Abandoned” instead of “Defeated”
The Teleporter is no longer used by the Auto Use Power Ups settings
The “The winning collection” achievement now reads “For every item, win a run with it in your backpack.”.
The base camp now has a usable toilet.
Bosses
Fixed: When a boss is picked at random, it is no longer the boss you just beat. Bosses you have never beaten come first, and bosses you haven’t beaten in a long time come back.
Fixed: Laz could take a very long time to appear on saves that had beaten the end boss before 1.0
Fixed: Quitting mid-run and continuing later could skip a boss in the boss order
Fixed: Scoop’s projectile impacts could deal no damage
Fixed: The Dumpling fight could never end when the boss had very high health
Fixed: The Surfboard did not damage bosses
Balancing
Hammer and Dice no longer trigger an extra time when you leave an event such as the merchant
Treasure Chest now gives its scrap at the end of the day instead of the start
Crossbow bounces now reduce damage, as they were meant to
Rerolling the bonus airdrop (every fifth crate) no longer raises its loot level again with each reroll
Fixes
Memos no longer appear in Endless or weekly challenges, and empty memo pickups no longer stay on the map
Single-handedly now counts all the hands your weapons use. Two one-handed weapons use two hands, so that run no longer qualifies.
Throwing Knives never triggered on-hit item effects
Throwing Knives broke right after being thrown on ship decks in harbor maps
Thrown items hit the overhead beams of bridges and the gates in the labyrinth
Merged projectiles triggered fewer on-hit item effects
Merged explosions dealt too little burn damage and triggered too few on-hit effects
Explosions could trigger on-hit item effects on things that are not enemies
Uranium explosions and Throwing Knives ignored the effect and projectile density settings
The Teleporter could drop you inside a house or into empty space
Reward crates could fly to the bus instead of landing near you
Upgrading a Robot Arm with the Hammer did not apply its new effect right away
Enemies freed from being stuck could end up inside the ground
Using the swing in the base could throw you out of the map
The base camp crowd shrank for the rest of your visit when a wanderer disappeared
Meta threat level dropped when you left the base for the main menu
Hands tutorial showing rotate action instead of continue
Inventory & UI
Selling or crafting away an item that gives extra hands could leave weapons equipped beyond your hand limit
The item you swapped out could stick to the cursor when the swap put you over the hand limit
A dragged item lost its selector markers when the inventory refreshed
Inventory selector tiles were drawn behind items and sat in the wrong place on rotated items
The reroll button disappeared on the next queued airdrop after you merged a reward
Rerolling a reward could leave health, armor or stamina above their maximum
Scrolling down in stash management could leave scrolling locked after you left it
The settings category reset stopped working after you closed and reopened settings
Some settings sliders could not reach their default value
The achievement popup was hidden during boss cutscenes, so you only heard it
The threat clock jumped around when your apple count was very high
The XP bar lagged behind when you picked up many orbs at once
The end-of-day screen showed your apple counter, which only belongs on the end-of-run screen
The intro was stretched on screens that are not 16:9
The Masterplan was cut off on screens narrower than 16:9
Tutorial bubbles on the bus inventory could stay stuck until you restarted
Co-op
Fixed the most common co-op crash, which mostly happened in long sessions
Player 2’s swapped-out item could duplicate into the stash
A mouse-dragged item was lost when a controller button was pressed
Player 2 lost health when a max-health item was removed for a moment
A dash could still carry you slightly outside the shared camera
Crashes
Crash during map travel when enemies dropped debris while being removed
Crash when releasing the mouse while holding to skip the intro or the ending
Crash from stopping a sound that had already ended
Crash from enemy hit effects during map travel
Rare crash in the base when a wanderer disappeared during a long stay
Rare crash when pressing B while dragging an item that freed a hand
Rare crash when a saved backpack contained an item from a newer game version
Performance
Missed projectiles from Dumpling, Laz and Scoop never despawned, which slowed the game down at high threat levels
Huge numbers of thrown items per second could freeze the game
Projectile visual effects are now capped per effect type
Leftover drones, attack warnings and cached weapons are now cleaned up properly
<3 Your Pixelsplit team

Dear Survivors,

Good news! Our second major summer update is out, and it’s a big one: Starting now, you can play with a friend in the new Couch Co-Op mode. It even works online via Steam Remote Play. This means you can invite anyone on your friends list to play along, even if they don’t own the game. The only catch: One of you needs a controller.

In addition, we’ve added a new coastal biome, perhaps our most beautiful one yet. To go along with it, you can unlock a new character with completely new gameplay mechanics and start surfing your way through hordes of zombies right away. More on that below.

notes.title: Everything is more fun when you're two

items.text: Today we'd like to introduce you to our new Co-Op mode. Can't wait to hear your feedback on it. Since our Early Access launch the Co-Op mode was the most wanted feature. Until the upcoming 1.0 full release, the Co-Op mode is in beta, so it may be unstable or unbalanced in some areas. Accordingly, all bug reports, suggestions, and feedback on this are a huge help to us, so please keep them coming.
You can enjoy the co-op mode the classic way (with two players on the couch) or play online with your friends via Steam Remote Play. Here’s a quick guide, but it’s really not complicated at all.

notes.title: New Biome: Welcome to the Beach

items.text: With the Coast Biome, we want to introduce you to what might just be the most beautiful biome yet. Well, maybe it’s only beautiful until the sun sets and hordes of zombies start chasing you across the pier, the beach, or the harbor.
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/69ddf949b174b0489da6aa603eb771aa2ceed367.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/c9da6ac1dc403db67fbdf0de8f4becd7ac25e49c.gif"]

Even during the day, though, you should watch out for our new type of enemy, the Vacationeer (Umbrella Zombie). So, as usual, grab some gas and loot as fast as you can and get out of there. Even if the new environment might tempt you to stick around...

notes.title: New Char: Surfing through the Apocalypse

items.text: One thing that could definitely help you staying alive is our new character, who, in keeping with the coastal biome theme, comes with an exciting new character item: the surfboard.
We’re excited to see what new playstyles you’ll develop based on the unique “surf instead of dash” ability.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/78d4a44e3794fa494c4e1a3e827e2eb952170f29.gif"]
How to unlock? -> Have 6 dashes worth of stamina.

In addition to the previously mentioned Umbrealla Zombie (The ,Vacationeer'), you can now encounter the Caveman Zombie in the Canyon Biome.Furthermore, our standard zombies have become more diverse. Gotta meet 'em all (sooner or later).
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/af821f5e093d4120985143663c17c4f447d35180.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/9095ccfed38ec30e6baf6c63a7920bb25fda9d6c.gif"]
As we know, the most important thing is good loot. To help us find it more easily and efficiently, our loot crates now light up in different colors, according to their highest contained loot rarity.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/f58184ffa314c69141094b48f24eb6451c2f8164.gif"]
What should also help with this is a new one-time unlock that enables an improved radar, which displays the rarity of loot crates as well as gas canisters.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/3721fd834cfd3a079ed2388de5d816fba6686009.png"]
We had a great time at Gamescom2026, where we presented the Co-Op mode for the first time. Thanks to our amazing community, that helped us out the weeks before with testing the update.

Dear Survivors,

Summer is just around the corner, and we want to give you a good reason not to expose yourself to the sun’s harmful UV rays. Instead, take a seat at your computer, draw the curtains, and check out the latest, comprehensive major update, “SUNSCREAM”.

This update adds the Headquarter Run, the game's new endgame and story climax. After surviving enough runs, you'll have gathered everything you need to strike back at MKing Corp — the fast-food franchise whose "Secret Sauce" started the whole outbreak.
Build a bomb, infiltrate the MKing headquarters across a multi-stage assault, defeat its CEO (final boss), and blow up the whole place sky-high. Oh yeah...!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/628b4148858c88416d89a8f12e8ff3fe7eafc0de.gif"]

This includes 3 new achievements. Also while beating bosses over and over you will be able to collect little memo snippets which you can read in the base, which should give you some sense of the backstory of the game.

While preparing for the Headquarter run the "MKing Response Level" will rise which gradually increases the difficulty of the game. This whole topic includes much more, but go and explore for yourself...

A new survivor joins the roster: Penny the Clown. She comes with the Funny Balloon: periodically (and on trigger) releases a balloon that slowly homes in on enemies and explodes on contact, with damage that scales as Penny levels up. Balloons also pop on their own after a few seconds. Make sure to check out the Character Item Modifiers, that you unlock after beating a boss.

Dear Survivors,

Good news! A surprise update featuring a brand-new - and somewhat questionably balanced - game mode: Weekly Mode is here, bringing you fresh challenges on a weekly basis. And yes, there’s a leaderboard. It’s wild; check it out and let us know what you think.
Our tooltips and savegame stability have been enhanced, and several bugs have been fixed.
In parallel, we’re working hard on our major summer update, which will let you travel to MKing Headquarters for the first time. Until then, stay safe and have fun in the new, amazing...
A new challenge starts every week. The same rules apply to everyone for each challenge, including
A randomly selected character
A random scoring system (kills, peak DPS, body count, etc.)

We had a few rare cases where save games could be lost. We've taken several measures to address this: more backups, more atomic IO operations, and a fix for cases where saving might not finish properly before the game closes.

Our batching for foliage was quite poor, which caused a lot of overhead. We've revised this so that most identical foliage is now drawn in a single batch. This should noticeably improve performance, depending on your device.
There is also a new setting for foliage density, allowing you to reduce foliage density (excluding trees) on weaker devices.

Dear Survivors,
Spring is just around the corner, while our next update is already available.
The spring update has turned out to be quite extensive; there are lots of new features, as well as some improvements and changes. Feel free to browse through the overview below.
Reminder: Don't forget to leave your feedback—during Early Access, your suggestions and bug reports can make all the difference.

A new survivor joins the roster! Bushy's mechanic revolves around Trap Seeds — plant seeds that sprout into deadly traps when enemies get close. Seeds can root enemies in place with a new Rooting status effect, locking them down for you to finish off. Bushy also gains bonus crit chance against rooted enemies. How to Unlock: Complete the "Sharp-Shooter" achievement (kill 1000 zombies with the rifle).
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/5f73159b7a1069d05237db9b9055d536dd8bcee1.png"]

Level up your character items in our fresh and reworked character selection screen! Each character's signature item can now be upgraded with modifier tickers that enhance its abilities. Upgrades are purchased with apples and persist across runs.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/54567e3c08365d42b8b6e25eb27bc5c75ccef21e.png"]

Tired of seeing items you never use? The new Banishing System in your base lets you permanently remove unwanted items from your loot pool (up to 10 items at highest tier). Banished items won't appear in airdrops, shops, or loot zombie drops. Unlock the Banishing at the workbench.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/f7bed9f47c178807ffd67050d7c93601eca12c03.gif"]
Track your performance across runs with the new Run History panel, accessible from the base. View detailed stats from your recent runs including:
Backpack contents from each run
Stat trends (enemies killed, items looted, level ups, days reached)
Enemy type breakdowns
Win/loss streaks per character
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/8d51139e8765f04b6f03fd71480f63a7f82b5283.gif"]Find it here, below the leaderboard. (Which you can now browse by season now, by the way.)
New Items
Razor Blade — has a chance to spawn additional razor projectiles. Activates on critical hits.
Nail & Spiked Bat — incl. new "Bleed" status effect. Craft the Spiked Bat ("Lucy") by using a Nail + Bandage.
Bandage — a new healing item. The Medkit has been reworked alongside it.
Propeller — Increases attack speed and movement speed
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/5c13cc6748e6aedcf7aa7b9c90ebdd39ffed1ee5.gif"]May I introduce you? This is Lucy...
A new Luck stat has been added to the game. Higher luck improves your chances by rerolling chance checks. Boost your luck with the Lucky Clover item.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/62e8ea35f9970d5ccebac43da1cf10a1c662c988.png"]

Hello Survivors,

2025 is drawing to a close. Together with our fantastic community, we had a great early access launch three months ago, and we are now delighted to present our second major update: Get ready for the SNOWVERLOAD.

In addition to new items and events, a powerful new character, and a new snowy biome, we wanted to add more depth to the game and give players more agency and weightier decisions to make on their road trip.
[p align="start"]A new survivor joins the fight! Before the zombie apocalypse, he delivered presents to children; now he delivers deadly airstrikes on zombie hordes.
The best part: sometimes these airstrikes leave behind gifts that you can add to your inventory. The more you collect, the more powerful your special ability becomes.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/f42f2894ce029f5bc991b6975b19af8307e870c5.gif"]
A dubious merchant who has some very special items on offer. Interested in a bloody hand, a second-hand syringe or a rotten heart? Then you've come to the right place…
Unlock the vendor at the workbench and he will appear from time to time. Take good care of yourself, because the items you can purchase from him come at a price beyond scrap currency.
Look, who is hiding suspiciously behind the trees? Can you spot him?
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/0aa97eceda5568dadc44e5a56d2f96230ea08afb.gif"]

This new feature means you'll face some totally new challenges when planning your road trip. Some stages on the map are now marked with an ‘!’ symbol. If you hover over these locations, you'll see what's different here compared to usual.
For example, the Reaper may appear earlier, the player may receive 150% experience points, only Elite Zombies may appear, or the chance of certain items may be increased.
This means that you now should put a little more thought into planning your route, but also ensures that every run will be unique and full of surprises.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/fd3808e0280132a984e7dbe9a32b77db18b10344.png"]

Thanks to this new feature, it is now possible to have multiple save games. This allows, for example, several people to play on the same device and have their own save game. It also means you can play the game again from the beginning without having to delete your save game.

What could be worse than being stranded with an empty tank in an area overrun by zombies? That's right: being stranded with an empty tank in front of a confusing maze where the precious petrol is hidden in the far corner. Let us know in the comments what you think of this new alternative to the Highway Blockade event.

[p align="start"]Thanks for your support, feedback and patience,
[p align="start"]Team Pixelsplit
[p align="start"]Hi everyone,
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]we've brewed up a spooky seasonal update packed with a new character, new events, major performance experiments, and a whole graveyard's worth of fixes. Let's get to the treats!
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]A new survivor joins the fight!

His mechanic is all about spawning Pumpkin Turrets! These turrets function as "triggerable" items. When another item in your build triggers them, they fire. This system is a bit more complex than other characters, and we can't wait to see the crazy builds you all come up with!
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109004/4216e7299265dd74a410c43a178210892f42801c.gif"]

[p align="start"]How to Unlock: Head to the "Fields" map in the meadow biome. Find and loot a Pumpkin Patch to get the Pumpkin item. To unlock the character, you have to keep that item in your backpack until you defeat the map's boss. In addition, you need to have a knife placed next to the pumpkin in your inventory.
[p align="start"]

[p align="start"]Give a little, get a little... back from the dead. This new event grants a Blood Bag (a free +1 Revive). When you use it, you get an Empty Blood Bag. Fill it up by killing zombies to turn it into a Zombie Blood Bag, which will revive you with 10% HP on your next death.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]This is locked by a new "Not Today" achievement.
[p align="start"]

[p align="start"]Why settle for just one character-specific item when you can have more? This new shop can appear during your runs, offering character items from other heroes you've already unlocked! (It won't offer the item for the character you're currently playing).
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]The costume shop can be unlocked with tape, after achieving the "Multiple personalities" achievement.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]And of course... we've added Halloween decorations here and there to get in the spirit!
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]We're testing some major optimizations. These could be game-changers for late-game lag, but they are experimental. Please let us know if you notice any strange behavior!

Projectile Merging: The game is now capped at 100 weapon projectiles per second. If you go over this cap, your projectiles will merge, increasing their damage and proccing effects multiple times. (Let the chaos be optimized!)
XP Orbs: Orbs now drop in different tiers (meaning fewer orbs on screen, but the same XP value) and can merge together.
Orb Trail Setting: You can now deactivate the XP orb trail in the Graphics Settings, which can sometimes be a performance hog.
Improved performance for Rat Impact, Poison Impact, lighters, throwable explosions (e.g., banana, grenade), and fire shoes.
[p align="start"]
Item description font is now bigger and easier to read.
The virtual keyboard will now pop up automatically where needed.
Map hints for character locking events: The Astronaut and Pumpkin events are now clearly marked with a "?" on the map.
Save Compatibility: You'll now see a popup if you try to "Continue" a run from a previous, incompatible game version. (Note: Endless Mode high scores won't be submitted from old saves).
Settings Tidy-Up: Moved the density parameters to the Graphics Settings menu.
Weapon sounds now have slight random pitches for more satisfying audio feedback.
Changed the (slightly jarring) confetti unlock sound.
[p align="start"]
Titan Blockage: This challenge now starts with fewer enemies, but more enemies will be added for every Titan you successfully defeat.
Normal Highway Blockage: A "hard mode" is now automatically activated after you kill the first boss on this map, resulting in more mobs. Good luck.

Find the Astronaut: We've added a dedicated map (with a space shuttle icon) for the canyon biome. This map guarantees the Space Shuttle will spawn, making it much easier to find and unlock the Astronaut.
Fixed enemy projectile damage being much lower than it should have been if the projectile didn't reach its max speed.
Fixed some items not showing up in the encyclopedia
Fixed spawned loot (from airdrops, etc.) sometimes landing in unreachable places.
Fixed loot speed on the Normal Highway blockage being dependent on your framerate.
Current health, armor, and stamina are now correctly clamped to their max values. (This fixes a bug where unequipped values could sometimes remain active).
Fixed a bug (hopefully!) where loading missions would rarely get stuck on the loading screen.
Fixed the Franky Boss's tackle sound sometimes looping forever.
Fixed the Apple Pie effect staying active even after unequipping it during an Airdrop.
Fixed the "Death" achievement not triggering if you died while having armor.
Fixed a rare bug where the player could dash onto an inaccessible cliff in canyon/mountain maps.
Fixed the mission choice map generation sometimes becoming unstable when unlocking a new event for the 4th-5th day (Highway Blockage).
Fixed Endless Mode not choosing a random boss if you hadn't beaten all bosses at least once.
Fixed that the Blob Ball will get stuck or fail to reach the player when you're near the burger building.
Fixed that the Blob Ball boss could be flung out of the boss arena by an Airdrop.
[p align="start"]

[p align="start"]Please note that due to these significant adjustments, we've had to reset the Endless Mode leaderboards. This was necessary to ensure the top spots remain competitive and reachable. You can view all previously wiped leaderboards here:
[p align="start"]

items.text: Hi everyone,

We've just released a new minor patch focused on improving save game stability and adding some early-game guidance. Your feedback has been invaluable, especially regarding initial player frustration and those pesky save bugs!

Early Game Guidance: We've introduced a small amount of early-game tutorialization. We're committed to keeping discovery a core part of the experience, but we felt a few very basic mechanics weren't clear, leading to unnecessary player frustration. This new guidance should clear those hurdles!
More Predictable Dash: The dash is now much more reliable. No more slipping around trees or, in the worst cases, dashing in the opposite direction you intended!

Save Game Stability: We’ve made major improvements to save game persistence. The new system creates a backup of the last stable save, uses a temporary file during the save process, and automatically reverts to the last working file if any errors occur. Your progress is safer than ever!
Blob Ball Boss: Fixed an issue where the Blob Ball boss would stop shooting projectiles in later Endless Mode games.
Power-up Crates: Power-up crates now consistently play the correct sound and break apart properly when destroyed.
Loud Confetti Sound: The sound effect for unlocking items has been volume-adjusted. (No more overly loud confetti!)
Airdrop Item Combining: Fixed a bug where combining items in the Airdrop could sometimes lock the continue button, forcing you to restart the day.
Repairing and Selling: The item tooltip will no longer get stuck when you attempt to repair and sell an item simultaneously. (Seriously, why are you doing that anyway?)
Pet Collision: Your pet will no longer block target evaluation raycasts.
Apple Press Currency: Currencies regarding the usage of the Apple Press are now saved correctly.
Unreachable Loot: Enemies and bosses will no longer spawn loot or experience out of the reachable play area.
Boss Defeated Cutscene: Fixed a bug that could cause the boss defeat cutscene to get stuck (e.g., the dynamite hovering but the explosion never triggering).
Stats Screen: The Stats screen will no longer sometimes display negative numbers.
Swining Chair Teleport: Fixed the bug where clicking a Point of Interest (POI) while sitting in the swinging chair in your base could sometimes teleport the player out of the map.
Share your thoughts and feeback with us and the community on our discord. You can even submit tickets directly to us via opendecks discord bot.

Hi everyone,
we've just released another hotfix addressing several key issues, especially performance problems with intense projectile builds.
Intense Projectile Builds: Late-game builds with many projectiles were causing significant lag. The game should now run much smoother with these types of builds.
VFX/Audio Culling: We've optimized performance by preventing certain visual effects (VFX) and audio cues from triggering when they are out of sight.
Mega-Freeze Fix: Corrected a bug that caused a severe freeze when shooting many projectiles per frame while enemies were nearly stacked on the player.
Armor Value Persistence: Unequipping armor items no longer leaves your armor amount intact. The displayed armor is now correctly capped to your actual maximum armor value.
Copyshop Scrap Deduction: Fixed an issue where the Copyshop was not correctly deducting the shown price from your scrap resources.
New Apple Press Save: The new apple press will now save properly under all circumstances.
Blob Boss Sub-Diversions: Resolved a bug where the Blob Boss sub-diversions sometimes flung out of the map boundaries.
Multi-Phase Boss Kill: Fixed an issue where bosses with multiple phases could sometimes become unkillable.
We reverted the fix for the persistence of armour values. This caused other issues, so we will need to completely refactor it in a future update.
This is what Early Access is all about—working together with you, the community.
Share your thoughts and feedback with us and the community on our Discord server. You can even submit tickets directly to us using the opendecks Discord bot.
— Team Pixelsplit
Hi everyone,
We've just released our latest patch, which includes major balancing changes!
Added: Apple Juicer to the base. This converts apples into Duct Tape with an exponential price increase.
Added: A new pre-wipe leaderboard POI. We've also moved the main leaderboard POI slightly to the right in the base.
Updated: The Endless Mode popup design and text. This now clearly communicates that the mode is experimental, is not the endgame, and is intended "just for fun."
Treasure Chest Rework: Removed the broken exponential scaling. It now provides more Crit Chance and a flat income per day, instead of exponential interest.
Void: Buffed damage increases.
Throwables: Buffed damage for Grenades, Bottles, and Molotovs.
Banana: Increased damage.
Rollerskates: In higher rarities, they now trigger marked items multiple times.
Walking Shoes: Reduced the "meters per trigger" requirement, allowing them to trigger more often.
Scopes: Now have an effect on throwables.
Nurse enemy healing: Decreased the healing timer (makes healing happen faster).
Endless Mode Bosses: A bit steeper HP scaling.
Battery: Now properly affects throwables.
Improved: If bookshelf, workbench or wardrope is not unlocked yet we show broken representation of these POIs to give a glimpse.
Fixed: The splash screen video crashing in rare cases
Fixed: The Reaper could sometimes spawn inside buildings.

Please note that due to these significant adjustments, we've had to reset the Endless Mode leaderboards. This was necessary to ensure the top spots remain competitive and reachable. You can view all previously wiped leaderboards here:

We are still in the process of processing all the old and new feedback, and are still a bit overwhelmed, but rest assured that we are constantly working on the game. Right now, our focus is on adding more early tutorialization, improving performance, and fixing rare crashes. New content is also in the making, but this will still take some time.
